# Frequentist Logistic Modeling

### Librerie e dati

```{r}
library(pROC)
library(yardstick)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
X_train <- readRDS("data/processed/X_train.rds")
X_test <- readRDS("data/processed/X_test.rds")
y_train <- readRDS("data/processed/y_train.rds")
y_test  <- readRDS("data/processed/y_test.rds")

means <- readRDS("data/processed/means.rds")
sds <- readRDS("data/processed/sds.rds")
```


# Stima Del Modello (ML)

```{r}
df_train <- as.data.frame(X_train)
df_train$y <- y_train

fit_frequentist <- glm(y ~ ., data = df_train, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

# Summary dei coefficienti e p-values
summary(fit_frequentist)
```


# Prediction su Rrain e Validation (ROC / PR-AUC)

```{r}
# Probabilità stimate in-sample (MLE point estimates)
p_hat_train_freq <- predict(fit_frequentist, newdata = df_train, type = "response")

# 1. ROC Curve & AUC
roc_train_freq <- roc(y_train, p_hat_train_freq)
auc_roc_freq   <- auc(roc_train_freq)

# 2. Precision-Recall Curve & PR-AUC
df_pr_train_freq <- tibble(
  truth = factor(y_train, levels = c(1, 0)),
  estimate = p_hat_train_freq
)
pr_auc_freq <- pr_auc(df_pr_train_freq, truth, estimate)$.estimate

cat("ROC-AUC :", round(auc_roc_freq, 4), "\n")
cat("PR-AUC  :", round(pr_auc_freq, 4), "\n\n")
```


# Threshold Tuning, Youden VS Cost-Sensitive

```{r}
# Youden Index
thr_youden_freq <- coords(roc_train_freq, "best", ret = "threshold")[[1]]

# Cost-Sensitive (Rapporto FN:FP = 10:1)
cost_fp <- 1
cost_fn <- 10

coord_all <- coords(roc_train_freq, "all", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
N_0 <- sum(y_train == 0)
N_1 <- sum(y_train == 1)

fpr <- 1 - coord_all$specificity
fnr <- 1 - coord_all$sensitivity
total_cost <- (cost_fp * fpr * N_0) + (cost_fn * fnr * N_1)

thr_cost_freq <- coord_all$threshold[which.min(total_cost)]

cat("Soglia Youden Index      :", round(thr_youden_freq, 4), "\n")
cat("Soglia Cost-Sensitive (1:10):", round(thr_cost_freq, 4), "\n\n")
```


# Prediction OUT-OF-SAMPLE (TEST SET) e Evaluation

```{r}
df_test <- as.data.frame(X_test)
p_hat_test_freq <- predict(fit_frequentist, newdata = df_test, type = "response")

evaluate_predictions <- function(y_true, p_hat, threshold, label) {
  y_pred <- ifelse(p_hat > threshold, 1, 0)
  
  TP <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 1)
  TN <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_true == 0)
  FP <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 0)
  FN <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_true == 1)
  
  tibble(
    Modello = "Frequentist",
    Metodo = label,
    Soglia = round(threshold, 4),
    Accuracy = round((TP + TN) / length(y_true), 4),
    Sensitivity = round(TP / (TP + FN), 4),
    Specificity = round(TN / (TN + FP), 4),
    Precision = round(TP / (TP + FP), 4),
    Costo_Totale = (cost_fp * FP) + (cost_fn * FN)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Risultati Out-of-Sample
res_freq_youden <- evaluate_predictions(y_test, p_hat_test_freq, thr_youden_freq, "Youden Index")
res_freq_cost   <- evaluate_predictions(y_test, p_hat_test_freq, thr_cost_freq,   "Cost-Sensitive (1:10)")

# salva resultati finali Out-of-Sample
# saveRDS(p_hat_test_freq, "data/processed/p_hat_test_freq.rds")
saveRDS(bind_rows(res_freq_youden, res_freq_cost), "data/processed/metrics_frequentist.rds")

```
